content.title: About
content.content: Kakadu plum (Terminalia ferdinandiana), also known as Gubinge or Murunga, is a small flowering plant native to northwestern Australia. It produces yellow-green fruit renowned globally for containing the highest concentration of natural vitamin C of any known plant source.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Contains up to 100 times more vitamin C than oranges.
Used by Indigenous Australians for thousands of years as food and traditional medicine.
Contains high levels of ellagic and gallic acids with strong antioxidant power.
Widely formulated into high-end cosmetic serums for collagen boosting.
Fruits mature during the Australian wet season.

items.title: Unrivaled Vitamin C Content
items.content: Supercharges collagen synthesis and provides top-tier free radical scavenging.

items.title: Rich in Ellagic Acid
items.content: Demonstrates antimicrobial and protective properties for tissue health.

items.title: Skin Radiance
items.content: Topical and dietary application supports skin brightening and elasticity.

items.title: Immune Defense
items.content: Extremely effective natural defense against oxidative stress.

items.title: High Oxalate Content
items.content: Contains oxalates; consume in moderation if susceptible to kidney stone formation.

items.title: Acidity Sensitivity
items.content: Extremely tart taste can cause mild digestive sensitivity if consumed raw in quantity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Usually consumed as freeze-dried powder added to smoothies, juices, yogurts, or incorporated into skincare serums.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store freeze-dried Kakadu plum powder in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from light.
